verdict.rationale: Orb's own docs say it automatically calculates recognized revenue in line with ASC 606. They also say it tracks recognized and deferred revenue from billing data and offers exports to financial systems, so the core of the story is directly supported. IFRS 15 is never mentioned, deferred revenue schedules are not described in detail, and nothing shows audit-ready recognition reports beyond generic exports. Missing for 10: explicit IFRS 15 support, documented deferred revenue schedule detail, audit-ready recognition report evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data

citations.quote: Orb automatically calculates recognized revenue in a way that accords with ASC606 guidelines.
Track recognized and deferred revenue with exports for financial systems.
Orb supports managed, daily exports of resource types to your data destination of your choice.
